subject_guess: tarantula-type spider (8 legs, fused cephalothorax+abdomen, no separate head or tail)
readings: head/mouth end at +x (cephalothorax tip near x=22-24); abdomen (rear, no legs) at -x, centered ~x=6: XY panel is the PROFILE (side view showing leg arches), ZY panel is the FRONT/rear view, XZ panel is the TOP view (shows leg splay in x-z)
XY panel: abdomen bulb spans x=2-10,y=8-16 -> center (6,12); cephalothorax spans x=10-24,y=8-15
XY panel: dorsal body line ~y=9, knee peaks rise to y~4-6, feet/ground contact ~y=15

XZ panel: leg spread across z=0 (top) to z=24 (bottom), body centerline z=12; hind-leg feet reach toward x=2, mid legs reach z=0/24 near x=8-15, front-leg hips near x=22 with feet curling back to x~21
ZY panel confirms legs symmetric about z=12 with same knee-height (y~4-6) and foot-height (y~15) as XY panel
cephalothorax attachment points for the four leg pairs read along x = 12 (rear), 15, 19, 22 (front) from XZ/XY panels
notes: Spider anatomy: cephalothorax (prosoma) is fused with the mouthparts/eyes so the head does NOT get its own leaf (protrusion test fails - it's trunk, not a flap); abdomen (opisthosoma) is trunk too, no external tail. Only the 4 leg pairs (8 legs total) count as leaves; small pedipalps/chelicerae visible in the renders are sub-flap detail per the spider-leg rule and are omitted. Spine was subdivided into pedicel + 3 cephalothorax segments purely to give each leg pair its own distinct, correctly-positioned attachment point along the carapace (read from the x=12/15/19/22 hip positions in the XZ/XY panels), matching the crab-style guidance that multiple leg pairs must not all hang off one hub. Each leg was split into 2 inferred segments (coxa/femur -> knee -> foot) since the render shows a clear knee bend but the intermediate joints between coxa/femur/patella/tibia are not separately distinguishable at this resolution. Left/right leg chains are fully independent, each rooted at its own spine node, joined only at the leaf level via the symmetric pairs list. y-values were flipped (frame dy = -(screen tick delta)) so hip->knee is a positive (upward) dy and knee->foot is negative (downward) dy, matching the arched-leg, feet-on-ground pose.
